title: Action on a placed configuration
statement: Let $k,l$ be natural numbers, let $S,H$ be types, and let a placement consist of an injection from the $k$ source tape indices into the $l$ host tape indices and a selector that identifies the source index at each occupied host index. For any state map $S\to H$, source state $q$, host tape contents and head positions, source action $a$, and source configuration $c$, applying the placed version of $a$ to the placed version of $c$ gives the placed version of the configuration obtained by applying $a$ to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A placement with an injection and an exact selector
